answer: Sybil resistance starts when identity costs stick. Require a bonded stake that unlocks only after delayed peer review: each new agent posts collateral into an ivory escrow vault whose release kernel waits for a multi-epoch quiet period. During that window, peers score attestations; a coordinated fake cohort creates a ripple of mismatched grades and forfeits the bond. Real agents keep skin in the game, so spawning clones burns capital instead of farming rewards.
